summary: Complete fresh independent audit of all 57 Chinese units, 89 temporal and active-date-hint checks, and 34 people after the final curation. The AD 938 order expressly dispatches An Chongruan with the consort for burial and is correctly retained as one discrete personal attestation, not a lifespan inference. The Last Emperor remains a distinct AD 938 posthumous burial reception. Zhu Wen's AD 852–912 bound is supported only by the hash-pinned external-primary birth and death witnesses, while Changle and Puning remain separate AD 907 ceremony-only records without an AD 907–921 interval or reception-to-life conversion. No unresolved chronology, unsupported endpoint, reception leak, or temporal-geometry defect remains.
